title: Mai ek bekas pardesi
body:
Mai ek bekas pardesi
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam jaate hue roke sajjad ne kaha
as-salam ay bekas baba bekas bete ka salam
as-salamun alaik ya ghareeb hussaina
mai ek bekas pardesi hoo mai laut ke aaunga
mai saath phoophi ke ay baba quran sunaunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
ho tum pe salam mera ay mere ghareeb padar
ek khaafla tha tera ek mai bhi chala lekar
mai ibne hussain hoo ay baba zaalim ko bataunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
ek rassi may baba haye bara galay hongay
sab chotay bade baba ek saath bandhe hongay
mehmil se girte bachon ko seene se lagaunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ko bin chadar jab dekh na paoge
tum noke sina se phir quran sunaoge
awaaz may teri ay baba awaaz milaunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
hum qaidi bane hongay darbar saja honga
haye tashte tala may aur sar tera rakha hoga
us pal may sakina ko baba kis tarha sambhalunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
maangega sakina ko ek shaami kaneezi may
marjaunga mai baba sunkar ye aseeri may
zehra ko shabi ko ay baba zaalim se bachaunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
teri yaad may ro ro kar zindan basayegi phir maut sakina ki hum sab ko rulayegi
mai uski lehad bhi ay baba haathon se banaunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
<<DIVIDER>>
pabande rasan yawar ye khaafila jab nikla
bemaar imam mera karta raha ye nowha
hai teri qasam mujhko baba tera naam bataunga
<<MINI>>
mai ek bekas pardesi....
